newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel's economic performance index up 0.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Israel's economic performance index up 0.5 pct.

text.p: Israel's economic performance or "S" index rose 0.5 percent in October, the Bank of Israel said on Thursday.

The "S" index is made up of three components: retail sales, which rose 2.0 percent in October following a 0.3 percent increase in September; imports, which rose 4.0 percent following a 13 percent increase in September; and industrial production, which rose 2.0 percent in September after a 0.4 percent gain in August.
Note: figures for industrial production lag a month.
The central bank said that in the first 10 months the index rose 4.5 percent against an 8.5 percent increase in the year-earlier period.
In the first four months of 1996 the index rose 3.5 percent while from April to August it was flat, followed by a one percent gain in September and October.
